definitions.gloss: buying a replacement; replacement purchase; upgrading
definitions.explanation: The act of purchasing a new item to replace an old or worn-out one. Common for appliances, electronics, cars, and other durable goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking about getting a new computer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{買|か}い{替|か}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's about time to replace the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{替|か}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are sometimes subsidies available when replacing your car.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb {買|か}い{替|か}える (to buy a replacement). Extremely common in consumer contexts — electronics, appliances, vehicles, and furniture. Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ (time to replace).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{替|か}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ (time for a replacement purchase)
- {買|か}い{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧ (to consider replacing)
- {買|か}い{替|か}え⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧ (replacement demand)
- ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{替|か}え (replacing one's smartphone)
